Fill the node's stores from a Stelae snapshot, Mithril or a local ImmutableDB

Usage: dolos bootstrap [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  mithril      Download a Mithril-certified ImmutableDB and replay it
  stelae       Restore a Stelae snapshot
  immutabledb  Replay the ImmutableDB of a local Cardano node database
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --force            Replace any data already in storage, and with it what an interrupted
                         bootstrap left for `--continue`
      --skip-if-data     Exit 0 without bootstrapping when storage already holds a node, as an
                         interrupted replay that has committed leaves one for `--continue` to
                         resume; data without one, as an interrupted stele restore or a bootstrap
                         interrupted before it commits a cursor leaves, and a store this release
                         refuses are errors instead
      --verbose          Enable verbose logging output
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
